items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.
items.claim: According to the text (Exodus 11:1), the LORD tells Moses that one more plague will come on Pharaoh and Egypt. After it, Pharaoh will let the Israelites go and will in fact drive them out completely. This is a statement made inside the narrative, not an independently confirmed historical event.
items.action: announces one final plague and predicts expulsion
items.object: Pharaoh and Egypt; the Israelites (addressed through Moses)
items.mechanism: A final plague is to break Pharaoh's resistance, leading him to release the Israelites and drive them out
